Who we are

Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.

Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.

At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.


The Opportunity

Every account we have today started as a name on somebody's list. We're looking for an Account Executive to go find the next wave - hunting, qualifying, and closing net-new business across a defined NAMER territory, from first cold outreach to signed contract. You'll carry the number for new-logo bookings, with direct access to leadership whenever a deal needs a push - it's a founder-led sales cycle, so when you ask, senior leadership jumps in. The upside matches the hunt: commissions are uncapped, plus a cut of deal revenue on top. And you'll do it all while selling and training on Mindtickle's own world-class revenue enablement platform, putting you at the forefront of the sales revolution you're helping build.

What You'll Drive

  • Own quota attainment for net-new logo bookings - every deal you close is a brand-new customer, not a renewal.
  • Build and run your own outbound pipeline - prospect, cold call, and break into net-new accounts instead of waiting for leads to land in your lap.
  • Qualify fast and disqualify faster - spend your time on deals that can actually close, not ones that just feel good to work.
  • Run full-cycle deals from first conversation to signature - discovery, demo, business case, negotiation, close.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees with persuasion, resilience, and hustle - new logos rarely have a single decision-maker.
  • Build the business case and ROI story that turns a skeptical buyer into a champion and wins executive sign-off.
  • Keep forecasts accurate and CRM data clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers, not just hope for it.
  • Partner across SDR, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Product to turn territory and market insight into pipeline.

What You Bring

  • CXO-level communication - you can win an economic buyer's attention and trust before they've ever heard of us.
  • A proven ability to navigate complex deals and internal dynamics - multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, no single decision-maker.
  • Persistent and driven - a stalled deal or a “not interested” doesn't end your pursuit, it just changes your next move.
  • A track record of building and closing net-new pipeline in quota-carrying SaaS or software sales, from first touch to signature.
  • Comfortable prospecting into cold accounts - you don't wait for a warm intro to start the conversation.
  • Experience owning an annual quota of at least $500K in new-business bookings, with the discipline to hit it consistently.
  • Familiarity with structured outbound or account-based prospecting methodologies (e.g. MEDDIC, Sandler, Challenger) would be an advantage.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling into revenue enablement, sales tech, or L&D/EdTech is a plus.
  • Prior President's Club or similar recognition for quota overachievement is nice to have.

How You'll Work with AI

At Mindtickle, AI is a collaborator, not just a tool. We expect every team member to actively use AI to move faster and think bigger.

  • Use Mindtickle's own AI-powered platform - conversation intelligence, AI role-plays, and deal execution tools - to prep, coach yourself, and run a sharper sales cycle.
  • Lean on AI to research and prioritize target accounts, turning a cold list into a ranked, personalized outbound sequence.
  • Feed AI-assisted analysis into your forecasting so your CRM hygiene holds up and your number is one leadership can trust.

What We Offer

  • One of the best commission plans in the industry - uncapped commissions plus a percentage of deal revenue, so your upside scales with your number, not against it.
  • Founder-led sales cycle - our co-founders work from the office and jump in directly when a deal needs a push, giving you real face time and full support in the room.
  • Sell and train on Mindtickle's own world-class revenue enablement platform - you'll be at the forefront of the sales revolution you're helping build.
  • Flexible hybrid work - we care about output
  • Unlimited paid time off, plus company holidays and all statutory leave entitlements
  • Comprehensive health coverage for you and your family
  • Wellness support - physical and mental health programmes
  • Learning & development access, including Mindtickle's own platform

If based in our India offices (Pune / Bangalore):

  • Fresh meals from our live kitchen - breakfast, lunch, and dinner covered
  • Unlimited tea, coffee, snacks, and beverages throughout the day
  • Spaces to focus, collaborate, or decompress between sessions
  • We mark the moments that matter - birthdays, work anniversaries, and the wins worth celebrating

Role Overview

We are transitioning our organization to an AI-first operational model. We are seeking an AI Product Engineer to architect and build the company’s central intelligence engine.

In this role, you will be the primary builder of automated intelligence systems—tools that not only retrieve insights but actively trigger workflows, and synthesize strategic intel across our entire business landscape.

Role Profile

This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role requiring a convergence of three distinct skill sets:

  1. Software Engineering (50%): Building scalable middleware, API integrations, and production-grade applications that connect our data stack to business tools (CRM, Marketing Automation, Support/Ticketing).

  2. AI Engineering (30%): Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.

  3. Data Analytics (20%): Leveraging SQL and B2B SaaS metrics to ensure all automation is grounded in accurate, governed data.

Key Responsibilities

1. Building the "Enterprise Brain" (Architecture & Integration)

  • Develop a unified intelligence layer that ingests signals from disparate sources (Product Telemetry, CRM, Call Transcripts, Marketing inputs) and processes them into actionable outputs.

  • Build robust integrations/webhooks to push AI-generated insights directly into workflow tools (e.g., pushing "Churn Risk" alerts into Salesforce

2. AI Logic & Agent Implementation

  • Architect "Agentic" workflows where LLMs are granted permission to perform tasks 

  • Implement advanced RAG to ground AI outputs in company documentation, historical data, and strategic context.

  • Ensure rigorous evaluation and guardrails for non-deterministic models to prevent "hallucinations" in critical business workflows.

3. Data Engineering & Governance

  • Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to ensure the underlying data pipelines support real-time or near-real-time AI applications.

  • Maintain security and privacy standards, ensuring that AI agents respect data access permissions across different departments.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Software Engineering: 3+ years of experience in Python development, with strong proficiency in API development (FastAPI/Django) and building integrations between SaaS platforms.

  • AI/ML Application: Proven experience building applications using LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks, Experience with "Agent" concepts.

  • Data Proficiency: Strong SQL skills and familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Business Systems Knowledge: Experience working with APIs for major B2B tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, Marketo).

  • Workflow Automation: Experience with tools like Airflow, Zapier/Make (advanced usage), or custom workflow engines.

  • B2B Domain Expertise: Understanding of the interplay between Sales, Product, and Customer Success.

Competencies

  • The "Builder" Mindset: You are comfortable taking a high-level strategic requirement from leadership (e.g., "We need to automate lead qualification") and independently architecting and coding the solution.

  • Systemic Thinking: You understand how a change in product data schema impacts the downstream marketing automation flow.

  • Adaptability: You can switch contexts rapidly—from debugging a SQL query for Strategy to refining a prompt for Customer Support automation.

    About the Role

    We are looking for a highly skilled and passionate product designer with an unwavering commitment to user-centered design. This passion translates into flawless execution, leveraging a deep understanding of design patterns to create best-in-class experiences across a variety of user journeys that are part of the Mindtickle content platform. 

    You will play a pivotal role in defining the strategy and vision for managing, generating, and sharing content for our key personas - enablement admin and sellers. Collaborating closely with designers, product managers, engineers, and researchers, you will design intuitive, engaging experiences that help revenue teams succeed.

    Responsibilities

    • Bring coherence to the content platform workflows, unifying AI content creation workflows and governance into one delightful experience for customers 

    • From concept to delivery, you will be responsible for defining the user experience, creating wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

    • Deeply understand user needs and behaviors: Conduct user research, analyze data, and synthesize insights to inform design decisions.

    • Design scalable, AI-enhanced, enterprise-grade analytics solutions for B2B SaaS.

    • Create frameworks and patterns that enable consistent visualization approaches across different feature areas and user journeys

    • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams: Work closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and other designers to ensure a cohesive and impactful user experience.

    • Stay up-to-date on industry trends: Keep abreast of the latest developments in design and AI.

    • Mentor and partner with junior designers to share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative learning environment. 

    Qualifications

    • Minimum of 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in product design, specifically in B2B SaaS environments.

    • Strong portfolio demonstrating complex problem-solving. Experience with designing AI products is a must-have.

    • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies.

    • Strategically builds consensus and trust across diverse stakeholders with competing priorities

    • Manages project expectations through appropriate visibility, negotiating scope and timelines to preserve design integrity while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.

    • Good understanding of design systems, UI libraries, and knowledge of how to build with these.

    • Navigates ambiguity and incomplete information confidently

    • Proficiency in design tools such as Figma and prototyping tools like Claude Design, Figma Make etc.

    • A link to your portfolio is mandatory to be considered for this role

    What we offer

    • Opportunity to shape the future of our platform.

    • Competitive compensation

    • Collaborative environment with a direct impact on product strategy

    • Work alongside top design professionals, sharpening your skills and expanding your design acumen.

    • Shape the next generation of designers by coaching and guiding junior team members in a collaborative environment.

    Mindtickle’s Professional Services team doesn’t just implement technology — we help customers transform how their revenue teams learn, perform, and grow.     This role is for someone who thinks beyond implementation. You care about whether the platform is adopted, whether teams are changing the way they work, whether reps are becoming more effective, and whether customers can clearly demonstrate the outcomes they’ve achieved.

    WHAT YOU’LL DO

    Implementation & Delivery

    • Lead customer kick-offs, define implementation strategies, and manage end-to-end deployments across commercial and enterprise accounts.

    • Translate customer requirements and business objectives into scalable platform solutions and implementation plans.

    • Advise customers on platform configuration, including user administration, content organization, reporting, analytics, and other capabilities aligned to their business context.

    • Build and manage launch plans in line with purchased services, timelines, dependencies, and desired business outcomes.

    • Own project governance and documentation, including project charters, scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, decisions, and time tracking.

    • Proactively identify delivery risks and dependencies, and drive resolution across customer and internal teams.

    AI Enablement & Adoption

    • Help customers assess their readiness for and adopt Mindtickle’s AI-powered capabilities and agent-based workflows.

    • Develop AI adoption and rollout strategies that align with customer priorities, operating models, and enablement maturity.

    • Identify opportunities where AI, automation, and intelligent workflows can improve productivity, rep effectiveness, and enablement outcomes.

    • Translate AI opportunities into practical implementation plans, adoption strategies, and measurable success metrics.

    • Bring a thoughtful perspective on how AI can be embedded into broader enablement programs and workflows — beyond simply deploying new features.

    Strategic Advisory & Change Management

    • Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business objectives and translate them into tailored enablement solutions using consulting expertise, platform capabilities, and cross-functional collaboration.

    • Design and execute change management strategies that drive adoption across program leaders, administrators, content authors, managers, and end users.

    • Help customers establish the people, processes, and governance required to independently manage and scale Mindtickle after launch.

    • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from administrators and program managers to executive sponsors, adapting your communication and engagement style to the customer’s organizational maturity and complexity.

    • Use customer data, performance insights, and analytics to identify knowledge and skill gaps, recommend targeted enablement strategies, and define meaningful KPIs.

    • Facilitate strategic planning workshops, business reviews, and post-launch optimization sessions to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

    • Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Sales, and Marketing to ensure continuity of customer value throughout the customer lifecycle.

    • Contribute to the growth and maturity of the Professional Services practice through case studies, webinars, thought leadership, and process improvement initiatives.

    WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

    REQUIRED

    • 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, implementation consulting, solutions consulting, or customer-facing SaaS delivery roles.
    • 3+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional, and global deployments in B2B SaaS environments.
    • Demonstrated experience driving technology adoption and organizational change across different customer segments, from SMB/commercial to enterprise — with ownership of outcomes, not just implementation plans.
    • Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and build trusted relationships at the program level.
    • Strong ability to translate data, dashboards, and customer insights into strategic recommendations and actionable decisions.
    • Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and technologies for productivity and workflow optimization.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

    NICE TO HAVE

    • Knowledge of sales enablement principles and the broader revenue technology ecosystem.
    • Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot and their integration with enablement workflows.
    • Background in management consulting or experience applying structured problem-solving and consulting frameworks.
    • Experience with AI, automation, or agent-based workflows in customer environments, including LLM-powered tools, AI agent frameworks, or AI readiness and adoption methodologies.

    This is an automation-first engineering role inside the security function.     "},{"text":"What You'll Drive","content":"

    • Automate evidence collection, control checks, and reporting for SOC 2, ISO, and privacy frameworks so compliance is continuous rather than a once-a-year scramble.

    • Comfort with AI-first development - Claude Code, and standing up MCP servers / tools / toolsets to wire AI into internal systems.

    • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001) and what "evidence" and "controls" mean in practice.

    • Solution mindset, attention to detail, and clear documentation habits.

    About the Role

    Sellers today jump between a dozen tools to prepare for a meeting, run a deal, and keep buyers engaged. We're bringing that work into one place, built AI-first, where the system knows the deal, suggests the next best move, and keeps seller and buyer on the same page.

    You'll own a piece of the experience sellers use every day to prepare and win their deals, and set the direction for where it goes next. You'll work closely with  Product Management, Engineering, UX Research, and Content Design, on state of the art AI powered experiences, from problem framing through launch. We hold a high bar for craft, so we are looking for people who can outdesign AI tools.

    Responsibilities

    • Own end-to-end design for the seller's daily experience, from problem framing and research through prototypes, high-fidelity design, and post-launch iteration.

    • Break ambiguous problems into clear bets and a sequenced plan that product and engineering can act on.

    • Design AI-native experiences where recommended practice and training, generated content, and conversational interfaces earn the seller's trust and leave them in control.

    • Design for multiple roles, looking at the same account (enablement admins, sales reps,  managers, and buyers), each seeing what they need.

    • Create patterns and frameworks that keep experiences consistent across surfaces and channels, and contribute them back to the design system.

    • Use research and product data to make decisions, and measure the impact of your work after launch.

    • Make judgment calls on scope, quality, and speed, and negotiate them openly with your partners.

    Qualifications

    • 5+ years designing complex products, mostly in B2B SaaS.

    • Shipped work on AI-powered products. Show us how you handled uncertainty, errors, and user trust.

    • Experience designing workflow-heavy tools for professionals. Experience with sales, CRM, or revenue products is a plus.

    • A portfolio that shows your thinking: the problem, the options you rejected, and why. Polished screens alone won't get you through.

    • Strong interaction and visual craft, and fluency in working with design systems and UI libraries.

    • Systems thinking: you design the underlying model before the screens.

    • You prototype to think, in Figma and AI prototyping tools such as Claude Design or Figma Make. Front-end skills are a big plus.

    • You're comfortable with incomplete information and can bring a team to a decision.

    • A link to your portfolio is mandatory to be considered for this role.

    What we offer

    • Significant ownership of an AI-first product at the center of how sellers work.

    • A global product used by enterprise revenue teams worldwide, built by a product team in India.

    • A best-in-class design team to learn from.

    • Competitive compensation

    The Staff Engineer is the senior individual contributor at Mindtickle. The role is defined by scope, not tenure or technology.

    Staff Engineers shape technical direction across teams. They take on problems that cross system boundaries, i.e., foundational platform decisions, architectural work that spans multiple services, performance and reliability challenges that no single team owns, and AI capabilities that need to be woven into the product rather than bolted on.

    This is not a senior engineer with a different title. The role exists for a different category of problem.

    "},{"text":"Key Responsibility","content":"

  • Solve Organization wide problems - crisply define the problem, propose the solution, implement it and get it adopted. One of the finest examples of this is the data platform at Mindtickle.

  • Take on problems that span teams — performance regressions across services, integration patterns that cut across domains, AI capabilities that have to hold up across varied customer configurations.

  • Review designs from other teams. Identify architectural risks before they become incidents. Propose and drive migrations, deprecations, and platform investments.

  • Set the technical standard through your work — the code you write, the design documents you publish, the reviews you give. Influence through clarity, not authority.

  • Be the champion of AI transformation at Mindtickle.  Evaluate where AI-native approaches should replace or augment traditional systems. Reasons about cost, latency, reliability, explainability, and maintenance burden. Help shape how the engineering organization itself uses AI tooling.

  • Own the operational health of the systems you influence. Drive reliability, observability, and performance work proactively, with data and clear proposals.

  • Make other engineers better — through design reviews, technical mentorship, and creating clarity in areas where others are stuck. Distribute knowledge rather than concentrate it.

  • Clear evidence of significant industry experience as an individual contributor in software engineering, with the most recent years operating at Staff scope or equivalent. Scope is defined by the kind of problem owned, not the title held.

  • Demonstrated architectural ownership. Evidence that you have defined or significantly shaped system architecture in production that has stood the test of time — structural decisions you made, not designs you implemented.

  • Cross-team technical influence. Concrete examples where your work has shaped systems beyond your immediate team and thrived — patterns adopted by others, disagreements resolved across boundaries, design proposals taken up by other teams.

  • Production discipline. Direct ownership of systems running in production, with demonstrated work on reliability, observability, or operational improvement that survived contact with real customers.

  • Incident management. Track record of leading the response to production incidents — driving diagnosis under pressure, owning the post-incident review, and translating findings into structural improvements that prevent recurrence.

  • Strong written technical communication. Design documents, RFCs, or technical proposals that articulate complex trade-offs in writing.

  • Depth in at least one domain: multi-tenant SaaS systems, integration-heavy platforms, workflow or rules engines, configuration-driven architectures, real-time analytics, data pipelines, or platform infrastructure serving multiple internal teams.

  • Judgment on complexity. A record of making systems simpler — deprecations led, abstractions removed, boring technology chosen where it sufficed.
